inlines.v: SWARD, noun 1. The skin of bacon. [Local.] 2. The grassy surface of land; turf; that part of the soil which is filled with the roots of grass, forming a kind of mat. When covered with green grass, it is called green sward SWARD, verb transitive To produce sward; to cover with sward SWARD'-CUTTER, noun An instrument for cutting sward across the ridges.
